title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Ordinary to moderate thunderstorms are expected

---Discussion---

Thunderstorms during the day are mostly forecast to be ordinary. 
stronger storms are expected towards the night and early morning of 17th August.

Thunderstorms in Czechia are expected to get moderate towards the early morning of 17th August (around 2:00-5:00 CEST), with high dls, lls and CAPE values up to 1100j/kg ML CAPE.
Tornado potential also exists over all of Bohemia, mostly the South region.
